face.name: 光沐元素
face.text: 嘲讽。亡语：&为所有友方角色恢复 8点生命值。
face.flavorText: 气象节目说，外面的天气可以洗澡了。你带好了伞，发现是日光浴。

face.name: Lightshower Elemental
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle:& Restore 8 Health to all friendly characters.
face.flavorText: The forecast calls for light showers, but you won’t need an umbrella.

face.name: 亡灵药剂师
face.text: 亡语：为每个英雄恢复 4点生命值。
face.flavorText: 相信我，我在喝下这瓶药水前就已经死了。

face.name: Mistress of Mixtures
face.text: Deathrattle: Restore 4 Health to each hero.
face.flavorText: Her favorite mixture is cola and lime.

face.name: 奖品商贩
face.text: 战吼，亡语：&每个玩家抽一张牌。
face.flavorText: 他只是想确认奖券是不是真的。正品奖券是草莓味的。

face.name: Prize Vendor
face.text: Battlecry and Deathrattle:& Each player draws a card.
face.flavorText: He's just making sure they're real. Authentic tickets taste like strawberry.

face.name: 强能箭猪
face.text: 亡语： 造成等同于本随从攻击力的伤害，随机分配到所有敌人身上。
face.flavorText: 上吧，爆壳猛猪，扎透他们！

face.name: Augmented Porcupine
face.text: Deathrattle: Deal this minion's Attack damage randomly split among all enemies.
face.flavorText: Pokey-man. Gotta spike 'em all!

face.name: 地底虫王
face.text: 突袭。战吼，亡语：&获得6点护甲值。
face.flavorText: “都看好了，我是地底虫王！我一直在你们下面，可是没人在我下面！我现在对和平与幸福宣战。要不了多久，一切都会在我面前颤抖！”

face.name: Underking
face.text: Rush Battlecry and Deathrattle:& Gain 6 Armor.
face.flavorText: "Behold, the Underking! I'm always beneath you, but nothing is beneath me! I hereby declare war on peace and happiness! Soon, all will tremble before me!"

face.name: 莫尔葛熔魔
face.text: 嘲讽，亡语：获得8点护甲值。
face.flavorText: 他不是因为邪能才变得暴躁，而是因为鼻子痒没法抓。

face.name: Mo'arg Forgefiend
face.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Gain 8 Armor.
face.flavorText: Enraged not by fel energies, but by an itchy nose he cannot scratch.

face.name: 沙赫柯特工兵
face.text: 亡语：随机将一个敌方随从移回对手的 手牌。
face.flavorText: “喏，你随从掉了。”

face.name: Sahket Sapper
face.text: Deathrattle: Return a random enemy minion to your opponent's hand.
face.flavorText: "Here, you dropped this."

face.name: 邪能响尾蛇
face.text: 突袭。亡语：&对所有敌方随从造成1点伤害。
face.flavorText: 亡语响起，陷入危险的却是你。

face.name: Felrattler
face.text: Rush Deathrattle:& Deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
face.flavorText: It only rattles when YOU'RE in danger.

face.name: 邪魔仆从
face.text: 亡语：&随机使一个友方随从获得本随从的攻击力。
face.flavorText: 当仆从只是邪魔的爱好，主人是谁无所谓。

face.name: Fiendish Servant
face.text: Deathrattle:& Give this minion's Attack to a random friendly minion.
face.flavorText: Putting the "r" in fiend.

face.name: 苦痛侍僧
face.text: 每当本随从受到伤害，抽一张牌。
face.flavorText: 在他年轻的时候，他经受的是“快乐侍僧”的训练，但是训练成果并不如他想象的那么好。

face.name: Acolyte of Pain
face.text: Whenever this minion takes damage, draw a card.
face.flavorText: He trained when he was younger to be an acolyte of joy, but things didn’t work out like he thought they would.

face.name: 死亡侍僧
face.text: 在一个友方亡灵死亡后，&抽一张牌。
face.flavorText: “我看到了死人。很多很多死人。”

face.name: Acolyte of Death
face.text: After a friendly Undead dies,& draw a card.
face.flavorText: "I see dead people. A LOT of dead people."

face.name: 战斗邪犬
face.text: 在你的英雄攻击后，&获得+1攻击力。
face.flavorText: 看到这个斧头斧脑的家伙没，这是我的战友。

face.name: Battlefiend
face.text: After your hero attacks,& gain +1 Attack.
face.flavorText: Say what you like about my hatchet-headed hooligan, he’s my battle-friend.

face.name: 哀嚎蒸汽
face.text: 在你使用一张元素牌后，获得+1攻击力。
face.flavorText: 不要再嚎了，汽大伤身。

face.name: Wailing Vapor
face.text: After you play an Elemental, gain +1 Attack.
face.flavorText: If you have The Vapors, your Humors might be imbalanced.
